children: Crown PropTech Acquisitions advanced its planned merger with Mkango Rare Earths through a series of material agreement updates. The parties signed an Amended and Restated Business Combination Agreement to consolidate prior changes and clarify equity issuance and reclassification steps. Crown PropTech and CIIG Management also amended the Sponsor Support Agreement, refining founder share escrow mechanics and adding a termination-at-closing trigger if at least $10 million of available gross SPAC cash is met. Additionally, the company revised the form of the Registration Rights and Lock-Up Agreement, shortening the NRA Investors’ lock-up to 180 days and confirming PubCo consideration shares are fully registrable.
